verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage offers transaction monitoring and payment screening, so telling legitimate AI buying agents apart from malicious bots is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents bot detection, agent identity verification, or any handling of agent-initiated purchases. Its 'agents' are its own internal compliance AI agents for screening and alert remediation, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the product distinguishes malicious bots from legitimate AI buying agents, so agent-driven purchases aren't blanket-blocked as fraud
